prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-02-25, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-02-25):
Fiscal period 2025 Q4 (filed 2026-02-25). Revenue 30,125M, gross margin 52%, operating income 5,855M (operating margin 19%), net income 4,617M, diluted EPS 14.0. Total assets 1,809,320M, total liabilities 1,684,348M, shareholders' equity 124,972M. Current assets 1,018,577M vs current liabilities 1,226,809M (current ratio 0.83), retained earnings 165,288M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The provided financials reflect a large financial institution (due to the >$1.8 T balance sheet versus ~$30 B quarterly revenue), with solid profitability (19% operating margin) but typical bank leverage (~6.9% tangible equity-to-assets) and sub-1 current ratio. These metrics align with an upper-medium investment-grade profile on a through-the-cycle basis, comparable to large global banks.
DECISION: A
